common.style_usage: Stardew Valley pixel art style: palette, outline weight, shingle and plank texture, lighting, and the front-on 3/4 camera of the cottage
common.reference_usage: exact camera angle and silhouette: front face square-on, roof seen as a band above it, no side faces visible

shop_a.description: a small cozy art supply shop cottage in Stardew Valley style, seen straight from the front: teal shingled gable roof with a small brick chimney, cream plaster walls with dark timber framing, a wide shop display window on the left showing small framed paintings and jars of paint, a wooden front door with a little round window, a hanging wooden sign above the door painted like an artist's palette, a flower box under the small right window. Isolated building only, no ground, no grass, no path, transparent background.

shop_b.description: a charming painter's shop building in Stardew Valley pixel art, front elevation: blue-green wooden shingle roof, warm cream walls with brown wooden beams, a large paned display window full of colorful paintings on easels, a green wooden door, a palette-shaped shop sign hanging from an iron bracket, potted flowers by the door. Building only, nothing around it, no ground, transparent background.
